_comment: Records the published dashboard URLs so future sessions/firings redeploy the SAME links instead of minting new ones. Two builds exist as of 2026-07-28: an in-conversation Artifact preview, and the real installable-PWA build on GitHub Pages. See scripts/generate_dashboard.py and agents/0_orchestrator.md's 'Dashboard refresh' step.

artifact.title: @makeitmanifest — Pipeline Dashboard
artifact.description: Daily-updated status dashboard for the YouTube automation content pipeline.
artifact.note: Self-contained single-file build (data: URI manifest/icons, no service worker) — the in-conversation preview only. Not installable as a real app on Android (Chrome requires real served files + a service worker for that, which an Artifact can't provide).

pages.url: PENDING — fill in once the owner enables GitHub Pages (Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions) on the now-public brajanniedz21/Idkk repo and .github/workflows/deploy-dashboard.yml has run once. Expected shape: https://brajanniedz21.github.io/Idkk/
pages.note: This is the canonical installable version — real manifest.json + icon-*.png + sw.js served over HTTPS. Install via Chrome/Android 'Install' or iOS Safari 'Add to Home Screen'. Once the pages URL is confirmed working, fill it in above.

refresh_policy: Regenerated once per daily trigger firing (end of cycle), never per-item, to keep maintenance cost near-zero. The Pages build updates itself for free via the GitHub Actions workflow on every push — no Artifact-tool call needed for it. Only artifact.html needs an explicit Artifact-tool republish. See agents/0_orchestrator.md 'Dashboard refresh' step.
